description: Starshipit shipping integration: rates from every courier on your Starshipit account, orders, labels, tracking and cancellations.

fields.description: Package size and weight used for rate quotes when a parcel has no dimensions, e.g. for checkout rates.
fields.label: Default Parcel Template

fields.description: Printing a label books the consignment with the courier, which is charged to your courier account. While this is off, Print Shipping Label refuses and labels are printed in Starshipit instead. Reprinting an existing label is always allowed.
fields.label: Allow Label Printing

fields.description: Paste this into Starshipit's tracking webhook (notification URL) setting, so tracking updates reach ERPNext as they happen. Keep it private: without a Webhook Secret, the token in it is the only check on incoming updates.
fields.label: Webhook URL

fields.description: Optional. The secret set with the webhook in Starshipit. When set, every webhook must carry a valid X-Starshipit-Signature, and the token in the URL is no longer used.
fields.label: Webhook Secret

name: Starshipit
